item.title: Man killed after entering perimeter of Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort
item.description: United States Secret Service ⁠agents have shot and killed a man who attempted to break into a secure perimeter at President Donald Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort in Florida, reports Reuters news agency.
